title: merge_notes
description: Merge multiple notes into a single consolidated note. The source notes are soft-deleted and a new merged note is created. Use when related notes should be combined into one comprehensive document.

note_ids.description: Array of note IDs (or 8-char prefixes) to merge. Order determines content sequence.

merged_content.description: The merged and reorganized content combining all source notes. Use rich markdown formatting.

title.description: Optional title for the merged note.

note_type.description: Optional semantic type for the merged note.
